answer: Each identity enters an 18-epoch evidence climb. After commitment, a summit beacon assigns five independent tasks; the kth account in one funding hollow must solve 5k tasks, so 100 aliases owe 25,250 verified outputs. An atlas Merkle root binds assignments, timestamps, and results. Validators replay 12% of tasks; a duplicate result or missed deadline burns a 45-POA bond and restarts every linked climb.
